title: Filling spray bottles with three dilution methods
audience: Cleaners who make up their own spray bottles from concentrate, packs or dilution systems.
learningOutcomes: Fill a spray bottle using a dilution control system, a pre-measured pack, or a measuring cup.
Set the strength of a bottle from the product label and the manufacturer's directions.
Label and check each bottle before it goes into use.

instruction.heading: Why the fill method matters
instruction.body: Solution strength decides how well a product works and how safe it is to use. A bottle made up too weak may leave residue or fail to disinfect. A bottle made up too strong can damage surfaces and leave a film. The label and the manufacturer's directions set the strength. The fill method is a reliable way to deliver that strength.

instruction.heading: Using a dilution control system
instruction.body: Switch on the water supply and remove the trigger sprayer from the bottle. Place the bottle under the fill tub, select the product, and press the solution button. Release it when the bottle is full. The system mixes the product and water. Fit the trigger sprayer back and label the bottle.

instruction.heading: Using pre-measured packs
instruction.body: Remove the trigger, fill the bottle with water and leave room for the pack. Open the pack and add its contents to the water. Replace the trigger and check that the pack matches the product written on the bottle's label.

instruction.heading: Measuring with a cup
instruction.body: Take off the trigger, add water to the bottle, leaving space for the chemical. Measure the amount the label gives into a cup, pour it into the bottle, and replace the trigger. Mix by gently turning the bottle. Do not shake a full bottle.

procedure: Choose the product and read the dilution on its label.
Put on eye protection and gloves.
Remove the trigger and fill the bottle with the method the site uses.
Add the product at the strength the label gives, and mix gently.
Replace the trigger, label the bottle with product, dilution and date, and check it works.

workedExamples.situation: A new cleaner fills a bottle with product and water, then realises the label dilution was never checked.
workedExamples.reasoning: Stop using the bottle. Empty and rinse it, check the label, and refill it to the correct strength. Label it with the product name, dilution and date, and read the product's safety data sheet before using it again.

equipmentAndPpe: Dilution control system, pre-measured packs, or concentrate, as the site uses

commonErrors.error: Guessing the dilution from the smell or the colour.
commonErrors.prevention: Read the label every time before filling.

commonErrors.error: Mixing two products in one bottle.
commonErrors.prevention: One product per bottle. Rinse the bottle between products.

commonErrors.error: Leaving the trigger off after filling.
commonErrors.prevention: Check the trigger is fitted and works before the bottle is used.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: Read the safety data sheet for a product before its first use.
Do not use a bottle that is unlabelled or whose contents are unknown.

qualityStandard: The bottle is labelled with product, dilution and date.
The trigger is fitted and tested.
documentationEvidence: Product and fill method recorded in the site log.
summary: The label and manufacturer's directions set the strength, every time.
Use one product per bottle, and label each bottle with product, dilution and date.
Check the trigger and the safety data sheet before use.

knowledgeChecks.question: What sets the correct strength for a spray bottle?
options: The label and the manufacturer's directions
How strong the cleaner smells in the room
The colour of the bottle and its cap

knowledgeChecks.question: Which method mixes the product and water for you as you fill the bottle?
You find a bottle with no label and an unknown liquid in it. What should you do?
options: Use it carefully, since it is probably the usual product
Do not use it; check it and relabel or discard it under site policy
Top it up with the usual product and then use it as normal
